scope: Browser tabs on the WebView2 109 fixed runtime and the registered system runtime, Windows 11 x64 development machine

system.windows: Microsoft Windows 11 家庭版 中文版

tests.uiSmoke: passed with DALIZI_BROWSER set to the installed Microsoft Edge

results: Desktop runtime check (search_drop_smoke --webview-runtime) passed on both runtimes: loopback navigation, back, extension dialog and tab close. On 109 the dialog reported the runtime version and hid the loader.

browser_smoke passed on both runtimes: hidden creation and layout, settings readback and apply, cookie/site-data clearing, downloads, link/blank-then-navigate/POST popups with postMessage and window.close. On 157 the disk cache was evicted and the MV3 fixture extension was installed, toggled and removed.
Before the fix, 109 reported window.open('') as about:blank#blocked and the popup was dropped. Blank popup targets are now normalized to about:blank.

On 109 a disk cache clear did not complete within 30 seconds through either ClearBrowsingData or Network.clearBrowserCache. A time-range clear finished after about 60 seconds, and a cookie clear issued afterwards waited behind it. Cache clearing is refused on runtimes before 110; cookie clearing completed in under 100 ms.
limits: Both runtimes ran on one Windows 11 x64 machine with test identifiers. Windows 7, 8.1 and early Windows 10 with a frozen runtime still require whole-system acceptance.
Runtimes between 110 and 156 were not tested; cache clearing is allowed on them.
